profile.headline: Cloud Optimization, SaaS, IaaS & AI Enthusiast | Driving Innovation in Performance and Scalability | Passionate About Enhancing User Experience and Operational Efficiency
profile.summary:
Proven leader ready to tackle complex challenges and drive innovation while promoting cross-functional collaboration. Extensive experience as a software engineer with a strong emphasis on  designing, implementing  and optimizing cloud-based infrastructure, systems and full-stack applications. Track record of cost-reduction initiatives, cloud resource optimization, automated deployment, and team mentorship.

Pursuing new professional challenges with a mission-oriented company, aiming to create value by leveraging my experience to identify areas for improvement, develop plans for execution and implement solutions to increase overall value and solve business problems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack)
positions.description:
• Focus on discovery and backlog grooming, including full-stack features that support log ingestion and UI visibility.
• Add supporting functionality for a new AI-based analysis feature in the Blumira platform. 
• Design and develop new features for ingesting and parsing logs from various security platforms, collaborating closely with frontend developers to ensure seamless data flow to the user interface.
• Lead investigation of team's North Star and day-to-day metrics as part of company-wide effort to increase observability, contributing backend APIs and frontend instrumentation strategies.
• Present process suggestions for reducing friction in development and documentation across the full stack.
positions.insights: Skills: Cross-functional Team Leadership · Financial Operations · Kubernetes · Docker · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Infrastructure Automation · Strategic Leadership · Processes Development · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior to Staff  Engineer - Performance
positions.description:
• Led a cross-functional, organization-wide initiative to optimize cloud resource utilization, resulting in hundreds of thousands in annual savings and improved system scalability.
• Owned performance strategy as product lead, gathering requirements across engineering and product, and translating them into a modular traffic generation platform and full-stack observability tooling.
• Mentored engineers and interns across multiple teams, providing guidance on performance engineering, test strategy, system design, and career development.
• Championed standardization of performance testing and documentation, influencing engineering-wide best practices for measurement, validation, and continuous optimization.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Demotron
positions.description:
• Engage with internal customers to curate scenarios and extend functionality to meet changing business needs.
• Collaborate with AWS, as part of partnership with New Relic, in the planning, developing and executing their re:invent 2018 and 2019 Game Day event.
• Investigate and integrate new technologies to showcase new New Relic features and products (Kubernetes, Mobile apps).
• Design and develop automated deployment platform of diverse language microservices (Android, Node.js, PHP, Ruby, Java, Python) along with their underlying infrastructure to enable Sales and Marketing demos of New Relic.
• Design and develop tools for team. Slack bot for handling channel requests and an AWS Lambda with embedded browser to create realistic, on-demand, user traffic through a website.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• SCRUM master
• Develop services to augment communications and processing features.
• Implement new back-end features using EJB, JPA, JMS and Spring to be deployed on GlassFish and Tomcat servers. 
• Design and implement UI specific REST, JSF, JavaScript, and Handlebars based features.
• Develop Integration Tests using JUnit and Arquillian.
• Create and maintain continuous integration projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• De-facto lead for local and remote team members in planned multimillion dollar revenue-expanding project to refactor existing JSP/Servlet/Struts based web storefront for deployment to multiple locales. 
• Update existing Java-based backend, including MSSQL Stored Procedures, for streamlining of storefront platform
• Collaborate with business development and marketing teams to design and implement new features and improve user experience.
• In charge of maintenance of customer support portal using PHP to connect to SalesForce data repository.
• Triage and resolve functional and usability issues with web product.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Indigo Press
positions.description:
•	Refactor existing legacy code for use with new REST based web enabled product.
•	Design and development of cross-platform UI code using Eclipse’s Standard Widget Toolkit (SWT) and Rich Client Platform (RCP) as well as proprietary frameworks as a member of a team of six developers.
•	Partner with marketing, managers and field personnel to quickly resolve customer escalations, (VistaPrint, Shutterfly,etc.), preventing approximately $1 million/day loses due to halts in production.
•	Lead effort to increase customer understanding for UI developers with informal digital press operator training.
•	Lead streamlining of localization process for entire digital front end UI components.
•	Mentor college intern.
•	Develop features for digital graphic asset processing backend code for HP’s Indigo Digital Press.
•	Design and implement UI features during aggressive release periods.
•	Design and develop functionality to provide job asset processing system configuration at initialization.
•	Develop process for internationalization of customer facing information in asset processing backend codebase.
•	Design and implement tools for the delivery of data-driven marketing collateral for HP’s Indigo Digital Press to drive a targeted $10 million increase in hardware and service sales.
•	Designed and implemented critical back-end text and image processing/placement algorithms using industry standard Personalized Print Markup Language (PPML) and XSL Formatting Objects (XSL-FO). 
•	Lead investigations of font processing and conversion to XML for inclusion in Variable Data Printing (VDP) jobs.
•	Co-developed presentation-layer for VDP J2EE multi-tiered web application using Struts framework, JSP, HTML, CSS, JS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop features for digital graphic asset processing backend code for HP’s Indigo Digital Press.
•	Design and implement UI features during aggressive release periods.
•	Design and develop functionality to provide job asset processing system configuration at initialization.
•	Develop process for internationalization of customer facing information in asset processing backend codebase.
•	Design and implement an automated test framework for early code problem detection to ensure integrity of code.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and implement tools for the delivery of data-driven marketing collateral for HP’s Indigo Digital Press to drive increase in hardware and service sales.
•	Co-developed numerous B2B applications (both web and desktop) used to automate the workflow for Variable Data Print (VDP) personalized print solutions for targeted marketing and retail promotional systems.
•	Designed and implemented critical back-end text and image processing/placement algorithms using industry standard Personalized Print Markup Language (PPML) and XSL Formatting Objects (XSL-FO). 
•	Lead investigations of font processing and conversion to XML for inclusion in Variable Data Printing (VDP) jobs.
•	Co-developed presentation-layer for VDP J2EE multi-tiered web application using Struts-like framework, JSP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

positions.title: Partner, President, Instructor
positions.description:
•	Involved in marketing, promotion and day-to-day operation of the gym, including creation and maintenance of the gym's website as the primary driver for new membership.
•	Boxing instructor.

organizations.name: CHIFOO (Computer-Human Interaction Forum of Oregon)
organizations.description:
CHIFOO is the local chapter of ACM SIGCHI, the ACM’s Special Interest Group on Computer-Human Interaction serving Oregon and Southwest Washington .

Vice-Chair. 

Duties included (but not limited to):
* Contact publishers to obtain book donations related to the topic of the yearly speaker series. 
* Develop relationships with potential sponsors for CHIFOO events. 
* Setup and tear down at events.

organizations.name: Miracle Theater Group
organizations.description:
•	Actively involved in devising marketing and promotion strategies to increase the Miracle Theater’s presence in the Portland Metro Area during a 5% increase in attendance and10% growth in revenue.
•	Led the planning of the Miracle Theater’s 25th Anniversary Gala.
•	Led effort to increase the theater’s marketability through an increased online presence.
